professionalSummary: Senior Firmware Engineer with ten years of embedded firmware experience, currently serving as senior engineer of record for a mid‑range industrial drive family.
Holds an accredited MEng in Electrical and Electronic Engineering.
Responsible for signing firmware release reviews, safety function test reports, and documenting release limitations and hand‑over conditions.
experienceHighlights: Senior Firmware Engineer and senior engineer of record for the mid‑range drive family since 2021, signing nine firmware release reviews and safety function test reports.
Firmware engineer at the same company from 2015 to 2021, totaling ten years of embedded firmware engineering.
Led firmware design for motor control and safety function modules for the mid‑range family.
Reviewed firmware changes from four other engineers under a documented review process.
Authored release limitation notes and hand‑over conditions for each release.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Signed safety function test report (one sample).
Degree certificate with accreditation statement (one sample).
Firmware repository references as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s education, experience, and specific responsibilities related to firmware release reviews, safety test reports, design leadership, and documentation of release limitations. They do not provide independent verification of the company’s industrial drive product line or external audit of safety compliance.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets all listed requirements based on provided evidence; human review recommended to confirm context and verify external references.

evidence.text: Education: MEng (master's degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering), 2015, from an accredited programme; the degree certificate and the accreditation statement are attached.

Senior Firmware Engineer and senior engineer of record for the mid-range drive family at an industrial drives maker since 2021, signing the firmware release reviews and the safety function test reports for the family's nine releases; firmware engineer at the same company from 2015 to 2021; ten years of embedded firmware engineering in all.

Senior Firmware Engineer and senior engineer of record for the mid-range drive family at an industrial drives maker since 2021, signing the firmware release reviews and the safety function test reports for the family's nine releases;
Signed the safety function test reports jointly with the functional safety engineer, as the safety process requires for the drive family.

Led the firmware design for the mid-range family's motor control and safety function modules and reviewed the four other firmware engineers' changes under the firmware review process, with the review records in the firmware repository.
Wrote the release limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each of the nine releases, filed with the release review.

supportedClaims.claim: Candidate led firmware design for a drive family and reviewed other engineers' firmware changes.
